basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old mechanical engineer from San Diego with a passion for cars and all things Marvel. When I'm not working on automotive projects or catching the latest superhero movies, you can find me exploring new backpack designs or planning my next trip to Las Vegas. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently single, I enjoy volunteering my time to help others, especially those who might be feeling a bit lonely.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in mechanical engineering and several years working in the automotive industry, I have an in-depth understanding of vehicle mechanics and design. My knowledge of Marvel comes from years of reading comics and following the MCU. I also engage in self-taught learning about travel and lifestyle topics, especially related to backpacking and LGBTQ+ experiences.
